_comment: break: 75 is aspirational, not currently met (~14%). @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner@10.0.0 has a targeted-test-selection defect: whenever it narrows a mutant run to a specific test subset (testNamePattern non-empty), testsCompleted comes back 0 and the mutant is reported Survived without running. sign.ts and jwks.ts have narrow, input-specific tests that trigger this path far more than generate.ts/kek.ts, so their scores read near zero regardless of test quality. totp.ts joins that list: its tests are RFC-vector it.each blocks, the same shape, and its reported score (6.25%, unchanged before and after adding ten more RFC 4226 vectors) was confirmed to be this defect rather than a coverage gap by applying each surviving mutant to the file directly and running `vitest run totp` outside Stryker — every truncation, modulo, counter-encoding and replay-guard mutant tried that way failed the suite; only two survived for real, and both are equivalent mutants (a symmetric +/-1 step window makes `currentStep - offset` produce the same three steps as `currentStep + offset`, and Buffer.from silently falls back to utf8 for an unrecognised encoding on this ASCII-only input). See .superpowers/sdd/2026-09-11-p1-oauth-oidc-core/task-7-report.md for the repro and root cause, and .superpowers/sdd/2026-09-15-p2b-credentials-mfa-sessions/task-15-report.md for totp.ts's manual verification. Do not lower break to make this pass; raise it once the runner is fixed.
